# PDF browser tools

This folder contains browser distributions used by the Sales tender-document demonstration.

- `pdf-lib` 1.17.1 — MIT License — https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib
- Mozilla PDF.js 3.11.174 — Apache License 2.0 — https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js

The libraries run locally in the browser. Uploaded PDF bytes are not sent by this HTML mockup to a server.
